Common Washing Machine Error Codes & Solutions

`”>

Machine Not Starting

A very common issue.

Possible Cause: Power supply issue, faulty main switch, or a problem with the door lock.
Solution: Check the power cord and socket. Ensure the door is securely closed. If the problem persists, you need a professional washing machine repair service.

`”>

Drum Not Spinning

Clothes remain soaking wet.

Possible Cause: Worn-out carbon brushes, faulty motor, or a snapped belt.
Solution: This usually requires professional intervention. Our technicians can diagnose the exact cause and perform the necessary washing machine repair.

`”>

Water Leakage

Puddles on the floor.

Possible Cause: Loose hoses, a crack in the drum, or a clogged drain pipe.
Solution: Check inlet and outlet hose connections. If you can’t find the source, call Atlas Aircon for immediate assistance to prevent water damage.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

How much does washing machine repair cost in Vadodara?

The cost of washing machine repair varies. Our basic inspection charge is ₹299. We provide a detailed quote after diagnosis, with transparent service charges for all parts and labor.

Do you offer a warranty on your repair services?

Yes! We are confident in our work. Atlas Aircon provides a 3-month guarantee on all our washing machine repair services and any parts we replace.

Which brands of washing machines do you repair?

We repair all major washing machine brands, including LG, Samsung, Whirlpool, IFB, Bosch, Godrej, Haier, Videocon, and more. Our technicians handle top-load, front-load, semi-automatic, and fully automatic models.

How quickly can you send a technician?

We pride ourselves on our quick response. We can typically dispatch a certified technician to your location in Vadodara within 60-90 minutes of your call for any washing machine service.

Is it better to repair or replace my washing machine?

If your machine is under 8-10 years old and the repair cost is less than 50% of a new one, repairing is usually more cost-effective. Our technicians provide an honest assessment to help you decide.
